requirements.title: Dummy data object characteristics are its declared attributes and deferred or dependent properties
requirements.definition: A dummy data object has characteristics for declared type, type parameters, shape except assumed-rank, corank, codimensions, intent, optionality, allocatable, ASYNCHRONOUS, CONTIGUOUS, VALUE, VOLATILE, polymorphism, pointer or target status, exact dependence of nonconstant type parameters or bounds, and assumed or deferred rank, shape, size, type, or type parameters.

pending.dummy-data-declared-type-characteristic: Use a generic interface with integer dummy returning 41 and real dummy returning 42; call with 1.0 real actual and expect 42 from sentinel -777. Wrong-specific sentinel makes the integer specific return -999, so resolving the real call to the integer specific is observable.
pending.dummy-data-type-parameters-characteristi: Use two character dummy specifics with distinct length handling, pass character(len=2) value "xy", and expect the length-2 branch to return 42.
pending.dummy-data-shape-characteristic: Use rank-one and rank-two array dummy specifics returning 41 and 42; pass RESHAPE([1,2,3,4],[2,2]) and expect 42 from sentinel -777. Wrong-specific sentinel makes the rank-one specific return -999, so a rank-two call resolved to the wrong specific is observable.
pending.dummy-data-corank-codimensions-character: Out of scope by user decision: coarray, image, and team facets are not exercised by this single-image source packet.
pending.dummy-data-intent-characteristic: Use future dummy-procedure compatibility rules with an abstract interface declaring INTENT(INOUT); conforming actual adds 1 to integer 41 and expect 42.
pending.dummy-data-optional-characteristic: Define subroutine s(x) with OPTIONAL integer x and explicit interface; call s(42) and inside PRESENT(x) selects result 42 rather than sentinel -14.
pending.dummy-data-allocatable-characteristic: Define explicit-interface subroutine s(x) with allocatable integer dummy; allocate actual to 42 before CALL and expect dummy observation 42.
pending.dummy-data-asynchronous-contiguous-value: Create future source-use cases for ASYNCHRONOUS, CONTIGUOUS, VALUE, and VOLATILE dummies using actual integer 42 or contiguous array [41,42]; compatibility diagnostics remain owned by their attribute rules.
pending.dummy-data-polymorphic-characteristic: Use CLASS(base) dummy receiving an extended-type actual with component 42; SELECT TYPE in the procedure observes the extension and returns 42.
pending.dummy-data-pointer-target-characteristic: Use one pointer dummy associated with target integer 42 and one TARGET dummy passed to a pointer assignment inside the procedure; initialized sentinels distinguish successful association.
pending.dummy-data-nonconstant-parameter-bound-d: Define subroutine s(n,a) with integer n and dummy a(n+1); pass n=1 and array [41,42], then assert SIZE(a)==2 and a(2)==42.
pending.dummy-data-assumed-or-deferred-propertie: Use assumed-shape dummy a(:) with actual [41,42] and deferred-length character allocatable dummy assigned "42"; assert SIZE(a)==2 and LEN(character)==2.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans establish distinguished non-default state first, then observe portable single-image properties such as exact integer values, exact character results, successful execution, or source-use attribution. Unnumbered program restrictions do not create a required processor diagnostic; negative examples for those facets are retained only as source-control material.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Diagnostics are not claimed unless a numbered constraint or syntax rule requires them; this scope contains no numbered R/C unit.
requirements.dependencies: Registered dependencies: clauses 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, and 13 for source form, declarations, expressions, execution constructs, data transfer, and formatting foundations already present in this suite. Unregistered dependencies retained for future fixtures: later clause 15 procedure reference, argument association, interface block, generic resolution, pure/simple/elemental, procedure pointer, and finalization rules; clauses 16, 17, and 18 for intrinsic and intrinsic-module procedures; clause 14 for modules and submodules; clause 3 terminology and clause 19 scoping/lifetime details.

accounting.rationale: Defines dummy data object characteristics, including coarray-related characteristics retained as out of scope.

review_rationale: Source registration for Clause 15 from its heading through 15.4.3.1: procedure concepts and classification, characteristics of procedures, dummy arguments and function results, and implicit and explicit interfaces (batch220). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; characteristic definitions are cross-referenced to the rules that act on them, and each explicit-interface requirement has a positive plan. Source accounting only.
